# Tracking-safe CTA

`email/tracking-safe-cta` &middot; content-level &middot; category: email

## Purpose

A button that appends UTM parameters to its link correctly, whatever the URL already contains.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | text |  |
| `href` | url |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `utm` | object { source, medium, campaign, content, term } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Solid button.
- **outline**: Outlined button. Sets `buttonVariant: outline`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `separator` | one of `auto`, `?`, `&` | `"auto"` |
| `buttonVariant` | one of `default`, `outline`, `subtle` | `"default"` |

## Responsive behavior

No dedicated responsive settings. It follows the width of the column or section it sits in.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A content/button, square corners in Outlook desktop. | Fine. | As content/button. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('email/tracking-safe-cta', {
  "label": "Shop the collection",
  "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer?sort=new#top",
  "utm": {
    "source": "klaviyo",
    "medium": "email",
    "campaign": "summer-launch",
    "content": "hero-button"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "email/tracking-safe-cta",
  "data": {
    "label": "Shop the collection",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer?sort=new#top",
    "utm": {
      "source": "klaviyo",
      "medium": "email",
      "campaign": "summer-launch",
      "content": "hero-button"
    }
  }
}
```
